name: Maacah
title: King of Gath
summary: Maacah (also known as Maakah) was the king of Gath, one of the Philistine city-states. He was the father of Achish, the Philistine king whom David sought refuge with when he fled from King Saul. Maacah is mentioned only briefly in the Bible as part of the Philistine royal lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as the father of Achish, king of Gath
keyEvents.description: Maacah is identified as the father of Achish, king of Gath, when David fled to Achish to escape Saul's persecution.

keyEvents.title: David's Flight to Gath
keyEvents.description: David sought refuge with Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath, along with his six hundred men and their families, and was allowed to live in Ziklag.

keyEvents.title: Achish Gives David Ziklag
keyEvents.description: Achish, son of Maacah, gave David the town of Ziklag as a place of residence, demonstrating the power and influence of the Philistine royal family.

keyEvents.title: David's Stay in Philistine Territory
keyEvents.description: David lived in the territory of Maacah's son for a year and four months, carrying out raids against other peoples while making Achish believe he was attacking Judah.
